decoder_state_bytes.checked_by: Rust const asserts and C _Static_assert in tests/host/ps2-pointer-differential.c

stack_frame_bytes.note: leaf functions: no push, sub rsp or call; only the caller-pushed 8-byte return address

permanent_allocations.evidence: .data and .bss sizes unchanged; decoder storage remains the existing 5-byte field in struct keyboard

performance.conditions: hosted x86_64 microbenchmark, release build, taskset single CPU, same archive as kernel; not kernel latency
performance.assessment: Rust adds about 1.2-2.0 ns per call (1.4-1.5x) from FFI null/alignment/overlap and state-validity checks absent in C. A PS/2 mouse delivers at most a few hundred bytes per second at the configured 100 samples/s, so the added cost is well under one microsecond per second of input.
